nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the recommended area of GUAs per resident according to the national relative legislation?
nodes.answer: The national relative legislation indicates 8m² of GUAs per resident.
nodes.paragraph: 2023a). However, the accessibility of GUAs is equally important as their existence, to provide all their services. According to the Geotechnical Chamber of Greece (Kombotiati 2019), only 10% of the municipal- ity of Athens is covered by GUAs corresponding to 3.84 m2 of GUAs per resident, whereas the national relative legislation ( 285 /5.03.2004, https:// www. et. gr/ api/ Downl loadFe ksApi/? fek pdf= 20040 400285) indicates 8m2 per resident. The 15-min city concept, firstly introduced by Moreno (2016), prevails among sustainable urban planning strategies (Alvarez 2022) and can be defined as an urban set-up where locals are able to access all of their basic essentials at distances that would not take them more than 15 min by foot or by bicycle (El-Murr et al. 2021; Moreno et al. 2021). The ultimate goal is to build cities that are more inhabitable, equitable, sustainable, and resilient. The Euro- pean Commission, in an attempt to promote urban climate adaptation, encourages further research in the 15-min city concept (Alvarez 2022) with a special focus on the walk - ing distance to GUAs (Poleman 2016; Kabisch et al.
